issues.title: Concurrency Race Condition in Shared Store
issues.why: The spec encourages a shared pnpm store across multiple projects but does not define locking behavior or handling for concurrent 'pnpm store prune' or '-Force' clean operations from multiple script instances.
issues.fix: Add a requirement to check for a global lockfile or skip 'store prune' if other run.ps1 processes are detected.

issues.title: Missing AC for Multi-Site Parallelism
issues.why: The 'Parallel Work Sync Output' document provides a complex implementation pattern for background jobs, but there is no corresponding Acceptance Criterion in 97-acceptance-criteria.md to verify ordered output or job failure recovery.
issues.fix: Add AC-11 verifying that -uas output is sorted by index and handles null job returns gracefully.

issues.title: Unresolved External Script References
issues.why: The Script Reference (02) and Changelog mention 'upload-plugin-v2.ps1' and 'upload-plugin-U-Q.ps1' as active components, but these files are not provided in the context nor pinned in the asset inventory.
issues.fix: Add the upload scripts to the AC-10 asset inventory pin or provide stubs in the templates folder.
